token.title: Token address
token.description: The address as given in the input.

riskLevel.title: Risk level
riskLevel.description: low: no fatal signal in the checks that ran; the exit was open when checked. medium: real signals, none fatal. high: do not proceed without review. unknown: a critical check could not run, never a green light.

driver.title: Driver
driver.description: The one signal that decided the verdict; null when nothing above ok fired.

dex.title: DEX or source
dex.description: The DEX of the pool the answer is about, as VetAgent's source names it; geckoterminal when VetAgent read the pool through its GeckoTerminal fallback, which does not name the DEX.

liquidityUsd.title: Liquidity (USD)
liquidityUsd.description: Liquidity of that pool in US dollars, as VetAgent counted it.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: How complete the input data was, not how safe the token is.

signals.title: Signals
signals.description: Every signal that fired, with its severity and category.

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.description: What the verdict rests on, including data_gaps when a check could not run.

nextAction.title: Next action
nextAction.description: Only on unknown. retry: a data source or the call failed. abstain: nothing can see the token. fix_input: the address or chain is not valid.

verdictSource.title: Verdict source
verdictSource.description: vetagent when VetAgent answered; actor when this Actor could not get an answer, in which case riskLevel is unknown and error says why.
